question: Should this PR be refreshed to retain only the exact-current-main baseline cleanup, or closed if current main's baseline is already equivalent?
rationale: The protected maintainer signal requires explicit handling, and current main has independently rewritten the facade since the PR base, so automation should not choose whether the remaining generated delta is worth landing.

options.title: Refresh and land baseline
options.body: Regenerate on current main, retain only still-valid baseline changes, and merge after the exact-head ratchet check passes.

options.title: Close if already equivalent
options.body: Close the PR if current main's generated baseline already contains the same removals and pairing entries.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land baseline
recommendation.body: Regenerate on current main, retain only still-valid baseline changes, and merge after the exact-head ratchet check passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ratchet and authored the follow-up, giving them the strongest context for deciding whether a refreshed baseline delta remains useful.
